# Test fixtures

This directory contains `.svdat` trace captures recorded from Espressif demo applications under the Apache-2.0 license. Each trace header contains the metadata entry `Author Espressif Inc`. The repository includes no third-party recordings.

## Traces (`traces/`)

| File | Target | Cores | Events | Duration | What it exercises |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `unicore.svdat` | ESP32-S31 | 1 | 142 280 | 18.0 s | Single-core bundled demo containing tasks, ISRs, seven FLOAT data series, heap tracing, and function traces. Included in the production build (`?url`-imported) alongside `unicore.elf`, and the fixture for DataPlot lane and function-instrumentation test cases. |
| `dualcore.svdat` | ESP32-S31 | 2 | 164 703 | 18.0 s | Dual-core bundled demo running identical workloads across both cores with IPC. Included in the production build alongside `dualcore.elf`, and serves as the general fixture for unit and end-to-end test suites. |
| `p4-mcore.svdat` | ESP32-P4 | 2 | 3 274 | 0.27 s | Short single-file multi-core capture that splits automatically on load. Used by multi-core lane and CPU load test cases. |
| `elf-id.svdat` | synthetic | 1 | 13 | — | Synthetic trace generated by `scripts/gen-elf-id-fixture.ts` containing an `ELF_SHA256` record and one heap allocation. Paired with `elf/demo-app.elf` for ELF verification and symbolization test cases. |
| `zephyr.svdat` | ESP32-H2 | 1 | 17 445 | 20.0 s | Zephyr `samples/subsys/tracing/basic`: two ping-pong threads, the system work queue, a mutex, a semaphore, a one-shot timer and named events. Included in the production build alongside `zephyr.elf`, whose symbols name the kernel objects in the event details. Selects the Zephyr OS event table and exercises `svEndCall` decoding. |
| `overflow.svdat` | synthetic | 2 | 103 | 0.1 s | Synthetic combined multi-core trace generated by `scripts/gen-overflow-fixture.ts`. Each core has two tasks, a SysTick ISR and two `svOverflow` packets (cumulative `drop_cnt` 40 and 100), each preceded by a 10 ms gap during which the running task changes. The first gap (30 ms to 40 ms) has identical timestamps on both cores; the second gaps (core 0: 79 ms to 89 ms, core 1: 60 ms to 70 ms) do not overlap. Used by overflow-handling test cases. |

The files `unicore.elf`, `dualcore.elf` and `zephyr.elf` are stripped build ELFs for the bundled demos (`objcopy --strip-debug`). They omit debug sections and include only symbol tables and allocated sections, reducing file size by approximately 8× compared to full builds. Because each ESP-IDF trace contains the `ELF_SHA256` digest of the original unstripped build ELF, `fixtures.ts` supplies the expected hash alongside the stripped ELF bytes. Zephyr records no such digest, so `zephyr.elf` loads unchecked.

### Regenerating `p4-mcore.svdat`

Flash the dual-core `sysview_tracing_heap_log` ESP-IDF example using JTAG apptrace. In OpenOCD, run `reset halt; esp appimage_offset 0x20000`, and place breakpoints at `heap_trace_start` and `heap_trace_stop` to bracket `esp sysview_mcore start file://...` and `esp sysview_mcore stop`.

### Regenerating `zephyr.svdat`

Build Zephyr's `samples/subsys/tracing/basic` for `esp32h2_devkitm` with `main.c` changed to call `run_tracing_workload()` on every ping-pong iteration and `SLEEPTIME` set to 50 ms, and with this configuration in place of `prj.conf`:

```
CONFIG_THREAD_NAME=y
CONFIG_DEBUG_THREAD_INFO=y
CONFIG_TRACING=y
CONFIG_SEGGER_SYSTEMVIEW=y
CONFIG_USE_SEGGER_RTT=y
CONFIG_SEGGER_SYSTEMVIEW_BOOT_ENABLE=n
CONFIG_SEGGER_SYSVIEW_RTT_BUFFER_SIZE=16384
CONFIG_SEGGER_SYSVIEW_APP_NAME="Zephyr tracing sample"
CONFIG_SYMTAB=y
CONFIG_TRACING_SYSCALL=n
```

Add a `Kconfig` next to the sample with a default-on symbol that does `select HAS_SEGGER_RTT if ZEPHYR_SEGGER_MODULE`. Flash the board, start OpenOCD with `board/esp32h2-builtin.cfg` and `init; reset run`, then record 20 s from the `SysView` RTT up-buffer through OpenOCD's Tcl port (the demo application's `rtt-capture.ts` does this; the buffer address comes from `nm zephyr.elf | grep _SEGGER_RTT`), and prepend the header OpenOCD writes for ESP-IDF captures (`;`, `; Version     SEGGER SystemViewer V3.60`, `; Author      Espressif Inc`, `;`, one per line). Strip the build's `zephyr.elf` with `objcopy --strip-debug` and update the digest in `fixtures.ts` with the SHA-256 of the unstripped file.

### Regenerating `overflow.svdat`

Run `npx tsx scripts/gen-overflow-fixture.ts`. The script hand-encodes the packets with fixed timestamps, so the output is byte-for-byte reproducible; it parses the result and checks the core count, event count, overflow count and task table before writing. Edit the event lists in the script to change the trace, and update the table above.

## ELF (`elf/`)

The `demo-app.elf` file is a minimal ELF32 binary generated by `scripts/gen-elf-id-fixture.ts` alongside `traces/elf-id.svdat`. Heap-caller symbolization test cases resolve its symbols (`app_main` and `loop_task`).
